summary: Honor exact qualification requested commit instead of ambiguous FETCH_HEAD; resolve requested commit SHA explicitly and checkout target_sha, ensuring mismatch against current dev is rejected safely before resources or lease.

incident_context.symptom: In run 37666640298, workflow was dispatched with requested payload 679add while workflow head was 0f557 (latest dev). git fetch had two refspecs (origin/dev then requested SHA), and git checkout FETCH_HEAD checked out the first entry (origin/dev 0f557), silently running against latest dev rather than the requested commit.
incident_context.root_cause: git checkout --detach FETCH_HEAD selects the first ref in FETCH_HEAD (refs/remotes/origin/dev), ignoring the second ref (${TARGET_REF}).
incident_context.resolution: Resolve TARGET_REF explicitly with git rev-parse --verify and checkout target_sha. Validate protected dev source guard ensures noncurrent requested SHA is safely rejected before allocating runner resources or taking the qualification lease.
